evals.prompt: Ship the finished login fix; get the PR merge-ready, I will merge. Local tests passed at revision A; review then fixed recovery code producing B, untested. Unrelated staged billing edits exist. Existing PR 42 is still head A, green with approval.
evals.expected_output: Preserve billing staging, verify B, publish only the login change to the existing PR, and establish readiness on B without merging.
expectations: Runs affected checks after the repair
Requires remote readiness evidence for B

evals.prompt: Ship this fix and merge when ready; you may commit and push, but do not message reviewers. All required checks and approvals match B, merge queue accepts B but PR remains open. Tools can keep observing.
evals.expected_output: Continue observing through confirmed merge, repairing within scope when needed and respecting the messaging restriction.
expectations: Does not call queue admission completed delivery
Continues observing until merged or concretely blocked

evals.prompt: Ship it. The finished scoped fix passes checks; no PR exists. There is no other endpoint or deployment context. Describe what ship it means and when you stop.
evals.expected_output: State the default merge-ready PR endpoint, review if needed, publish, and follow remote gates to readiness. Do not collapse ready-for-review into merge-ready or infer deployment authority.
expectations: Requires applicable remote readiness gates before stopping successfully
Does not select merge or deployment by default
